name: cx-rules-only~p3
task: Do not take the box from the other room. At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the clauses match the task. Absence(target_picked_up) hard covers 'do not take the box'; Response(has_door_key, door_open) soft with 'try' covers having the door open at that moment or afterwards while holding the key; Absence(key_lost) soft is right for 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' because key_lost is defined exactly as a drop of the key while the door is not open. Rule-only with empty FINAL_STATES is valid: the task is all restrictions and preferences.
